identity: FANN Fashion is a men's fashion brand within the NSQ.global portfolio, entering through premium underwear.
Its core experience combines confidence, comfort and personal identity.
The approved brand promise is: Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.
The approved tagline is: Support in Style.

The current collection architecture is Silver Line, Gold Line, Platinum Line, Black Line and Legacy Line, with Seasonal / Special Editions covering Halloween, Christmas, Birthday, New Year and Valentine’s.
The current launch and website exclude X Edition and erotic-themed underwear.
Warrior Line is a historical source name; use Legacy Line in current product, collection and website naming.
The user-supplied FANN_Logo-2.png is the approved mark for initial use; retain Bank Gothic and Montserrat as the typography pairing.
voice: Brand promise: Designed for Confidence. Engineered for Comfort.
Both approved lines belong in the brand system; neither replaces the other.

principles: Confidence begins within. The first layer should reinforce composure and a sense of self, whether or not anyone else sees it.
Comfort is a design requirement. Visual impact must be reconciled with fit, movement, seam feel and sustained wear through physical development.
Form should have purpose. Proportion, panel lines, texture and details should work together rather than accumulate decoration.
Identity is personal. Different collections offer different degrees of expression within a coherent FANN design language.
Strength is self-directed. Legacy explores discipline, honour, resilience, vision, courage and responsibility through narrative and form.
Refined expression is deliberate. Confidence does not depend on shock, aggression, or conspicuous branding.
Product truth matters. Describe development intentions as intentions; publish material and performance claims only when substantiated.
experience: Governing outcome: a visitor understands FANN's relationship between confidence, comfort and personal expression, then finds the collection that fits their character.
Proposed journey: brand promise → collection choice → design intent → garment preview → fit and evidence when available → appropriate next action.
Proposed governing visual idea: precise garment structure emerging from quiet space, with warm accents used sparingly.

Proposed core/statement hierarchy: introduce Silver, Gold and Platinum as everyday expressions; give Black and Legacy distinct editorial moments without making the everyday products depend on mythology.
Proposed Legacy interpretation: chosen personal values, expressed with refinement rather than costume, aggression or eroticism.
Proposed mobile behavior: clear text and image hierarchy, short readable sections and deliberate collection navigation.
Proposed motion: restrained transitions that preserve a complete static and reduced-motion experience.
Current invitation: explore the concepts; activate signup only when consent text, privacy information and delivery have been configured.
